mapper.select: SELECT id, building_code AS buildingCode, road_address AS roadAddress, jibun_address AS jibunAddress, bld_nm AS bldNm, dong_nm AS dongNm, pnu, latitude, longitude FROM building WHERE id = #{buildingId}

SELECT i.infra_category AS infraCategory, si.infra_name AS infraName, si.distance_m AS distanceM, i.nearest_walk_minutes AS walkMinutes, si.latitude AS latitude, si.longitude AS longitude FROM infrastructure i INNER JOIN infrastructure_detail si ON i.id = si.infra_id WHERE i.building_id = #{buildingId} AND si.sort_order = 1

SELECT i.infra_category AS infraCategory, d.infra_name AS infraName, d.distance_m AS distanceM, CEIL(d.distance_m / 67) AS walkMinutes, d.latitude AS latitude, d.longitude AS longitude FROM infrastructure i INNER JOIN infrastructure_detail d ON i.id = d.infra_id WHERE i.building_id = #{buildingId} AND d.sort_order <= 3 ORDER BY i.infra_category, d.sort_order
